mlag.note: Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation for two-switch active-active LAG. Requires UniFi Network 8.5.6 or later

stacking.note: No hardware stacking; use MC-LAG for multichassis redundancy

routing.summary: Inter-VLAN routing, static routes, DHCP server and relay on the published tech specs. Some store listings mention BGP; not shown on techspecs.ui.com

routeScale: 256 IPv4 static routes (tech specs); ARP 96,000 on some reseller pages

redundancy.detail: Two hot-swap 550W PSUs included; 1+1 redundant. Five hot-swap fans (4+1)

licensing: No switch licensing; managed from UniFi Network 8.5.6+
verifyNote: Confirm whether BGP is available in current UniFi Network builds; the Ubiquiti tech specs page lists static routing only

models.note: 48x 10/25G SFP28 (1G not supported) + 6x 40/100G QSFP28. Full-depth 1U; four-post rack recommended
